intro: EHN Bellwood Nova Scotia is a 16-bed inpatient addiction centre on Highway 201 in Lawrencetown, in the Annapolis Valley. It was known for years as Ledgehill Treatment Centre, the name our listing used, and EHN Canada now runs it under the Bellwood name it also uses in Toronto. It treats alcohol and drug addiction together with mental health problems, with on-site detox beds, a pharmacy and nurses and counsellors around the clock.

Ledgehill Treatment Centre is a leading provider of evidence-based addiction recovery treatment. They specialize in treating addiction, trauma, and mental health, using a holistic approach that aims to heal the person as a whole. The treatment programs are tailored to each client’s unique needs, incorporating individual counseling, physical exercise, and various types of therapy such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT). They also use 12-Step facilitation and relapse prevention to ensure long-term recovery.

Ledgehill Treatment Centre takes pride in its ability to provide long-lasting addiction recovery solutions to its clients. Their approach is based on an understanding that addiction is a complex issue that requires a multi-faceted solution. Their addiction recovery program is designed to target physical, psychological, and social factors that contribute to addiction.

pillars.title: Online and In-Person Addiction Recovery Programs
pillars.body: Ledgehill Treatment Centre provides four unique programs that cater to addiction and mental health: Return to Wellness, Mood and Anxiety, Family Treatment Support, and Addiction Recovery. The programs provide intensive outpatient support that is tailored to the patient’s specific needs, and clients can access them either in-person or online.

pillars.title: Finding Serenity in a Beautiful Location
pillars.body: Ledgehill Treatment Centre is tucked away in the serene and picturesque area of Lawrencetown, Nova Scotia, Canada. The facility is spread over 110-acres of land that includes fields, woods, and scenic shorelines. The property is coined, “the Ledge on the hill,” and has numerous quiet places and paths to explore.

pillars.title: A Year of Aftercare and Alumni Support
pillars.body: Eligible patients who finish treatment get a year of aftercare, built around a weekly therapy group with other alumni, plus lifelong membership in the EHN Canada Alumni Association. Peer support through AA and SMART Recovery starts during the stay and carries on after you go home. Families can join EHN's family program, which combines structured family therapy sessions with education about addiction.

overviewH2: EHN Bellwood Nova Scotia: Centre Overview
overview: Ledgehill Treatment Centre is dedicated to providing a safe and supportive environment for individuals struggling with addiction and mental health disorders. With an experienced team of medical professionals and therapists, the center offers a range of evidence-based treatments and therapies to suit each patient’s unique needs. From intensive group therapy sessions to one-on-one counseling and personalized treatment plans, Ledgehill Treatment Centre is committed to helping patients achieve lasting recovery.

Located in a beautiful natural setting, Ledgehill Treatment Centre provides a tranquil and peaceful environment for patients to focus on their recovery. The center boasts comfortable accommodations and a welcoming atmosphere, complete with cozy amenities that promote relaxation and healing. Here, patients can take advantage of the serene surroundings, access to outdoor activities, and dedicated staff who are available 24/7 to provide support and guidance throughout the recovery journey.

afterOverview: These programs are designed to offer flexible options for those who are unable to commit to a fully-residential addiction treatment program. Whether clients are struggling with an addiction to drugs, alcohol, or other addictive substances and behaviors, Ledgehill’s programs provide the support and guidance they need to overcome their addictions and live a healthier, happier life.

Apart from offering a tranquil environment for addiction recovery, Ledgehill Treatment Centre also includes weekend recreational outings and nutritious meals on-site. Clients can relax in private or semi-private rooms that have en-suite bathrooms and enjoy the refreshing beauty of their surroundings, which can also help to improve their mental health.

The inpatient addiction program treats substance use and mental health together, and uses medication-assisted treatment when it is needed. The hybrid program starts with two weeks in Lawrencetown, then moves to eight weeks of online therapy from home, about nine hours a week with master's-level clinicians. No referral is needed. Admissions shares pricing after a free assessment and can check what your insurance plan covers.

location.heading: EHN Bellwood Nova Scotia in Lawrencetown, Nova Scotia
location.intro: EHN Bellwood Nova Scotia sits on Highway 201 just outside Lawrencetown, in the Annapolis Valley between Middleton and Bridgetown. Halifax is about an hour and 50 minutes east on Highway 101, Middleton is roughly 10 minutes away and Kentville about 45 minutes. Annapolis Royal is about half an hour west, and Digby, with its ferry to Saint John, is a little under an hour.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and the EHN Canada website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: What is the duration of the program?
faqs.a: The average duration of the program is seven weeks, but longer stays are available.

faqs.q: What is the cost of treatment?
faqs.a: The cost of treatment depends on the individual’s needs and insurance coverage. Ledgehill accepts most private insurance.

faqs.q: Does EHN Bellwood Nova Scotia offer medical detox?
faqs.a: Yes. The centre has its own detox beds and pharmacy, and nurses are available 24/7 to manage withdrawal. Medication-assisted treatment is used when needed to make detox safer and more comfortable.

faqs.q: How many people are in treatment at once?
faqs.a: EHN Bellwood Nova Scotia has 16 beds, so the group stays small. EHN says this keeps the clinician-to-patient ratio high.

The hybrid program is two weeks of inpatient care in Lawrencetown, with detox if you need it, followed by eight weeks of online treatment from home. The online part is about nine hours a week of group and individual therapy with master's-level clinicians, and it is followed by aftercare.
Yes, both online and in-person programs are available.

faqs.q: What types of therapy are offered?
faqs.a: Ledgehill Treatment Centre offers a range of therapies such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT).

faqs.q: Where is EHN Bellwood Nova Scotia and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 7608 Highway 201 in Lawrencetown, in Nova Scotia's Annapolis Valley between Middleton and Bridgetown. It is about an hour and 50 minutes from Halifax on Highway 101, roughly 10 minutes from Middleton and about 45 minutes from Kentville.

No. EHN Bellwood Nova Scotia is a private centre, so you or a family member can call admissions directly for an assessment and skip public wait lists. Complex cases are reviewed one by one by the clinical team.

faqs.q: What support is there after treatment?
faqs.a: Eligible patients get a year of aftercare with a weekly therapy group for alumni, and lifelong membership in the EHN Canada Alumni Association. AA and SMART Recovery peer support also continues after discharge.
Yes, family therapy is available, and families are welcome to visit with their loved ones.
